newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Venezuela decision on new oilfield auction soon.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela decision on new oilfield auction soon.

text.p: Venezuela's deputy energy minister said on Friday he expected the government would decide by November to tell state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) to prepare a fourth bidding round for mature oilfields for 1998.

Deputy Energy and Mines Minister Evanan Romero told Reuters he was "very optimistic" that his ministry would decide "before the end of October" that it would be viable to launch a fourth bidding round for nine or 10 mature fields next year.
"We are considering very positively the need to maintain this momentum," he added.
The minister was speaking in the margins of a conference on trade and investment opportunities in Venezuela's energy and petrochemicals sector, organised by the Belgian Foreign Trade Board.
Venezuela last month auctioned operating contracts for 18 mature fields to local and international companies in a highly competitive bidding round that brought in bids totalling over $2.1 billion.
PDVSA is due to sign the contracts on August 1, Romero said.
The minister said he expected a fourth bidding round would include two fields offered for auction last month but for which contracts were not awarded.
He said it would be necessary to make a decision on a fourth bidding round by November if the auction was to go ahead next year. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
